notes.title: The BIG Update
notes.content:
The BIG Update features many changes focused on making it easier for new users, and improving the overall experience. These include-

-A shape guide to show where the shape will land, and how far it has to drop, making it much easier to place shapes where you want them.
-The next shape is now a separate display in non-VR mode, allowing the tower to be bigger on screen.
-Tweaks to the custom designs to improve their visibility in game.
-An overhaul of the menu, making it easier to navigate.
-Clearer messaging of modes and features.
-Clearer information and demo of the game you are selecting.
-Tips on the title screen to help new players.
-Many other small tweaks and bug fixes.

Combined with the recent Practice Mode and Visibility Updates, it's never been easier to get twisting.

Special thanks to Cir9Pro and Creative Name for the amazing feedback.

notes.title: Visibility Update
notes.content:
-Blocks at the back of the tower are now darker, making it clearer to see what's going on.
-A few other small tweaks and fixes.

notes.title: Practice Mode Update
notes.content:
In Practice Mode the shapes only fall when you drop them, so you can learn your strategy without the pressure.

Available in both game types and all difficulties.
